# Retired formats (negative fixtures)

One document of each format the historical `0.5.0` package produced (report 2.0.0,
request 2.0.0, artifact 1.0.0, run-result 2.0.0, item-record 1.0.0), taken from its
published schema fixtures. `0.1.0` reads none of them: the installed-package test proves
the replacement readers and the CLI refuse each one.
